# TaskFlow

> Collaborative task management with Jira-style boards, workspace roles, comments, attachments, and secure cookie sessions. Built with Next.js App Router and Express.

TaskFlow is a portfolio-grade SaaS app for teams that want a focused kanban board: columns, priorities, flags, keyboard-friendly drag and drop, task detail panels, workspaces, and member roles. Authentication uses httpOnly cookies through a Next.js backend-for-frontend; tokens are never stored in browser localStorage.

## Key facts

- Product name: TaskFlow
- Category: collaborative task management / kanban software
- Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Express 4, Prisma, Zod, Neon PostgreSQL or in-memory demo store
- Canonical English site: https://taskflow-web-syed-ali.vercel.app/en
- Available locales: en, ru, es, ar, hi, fr, de
- First-time guide: https://taskflow-web-syed-ali.vercel.app/en/guide
- Sign in: https://taskflow-web-syed-ali.vercel.app/en/login (not indexed)
- Demo owner: Syed Ali, syed.ali@taskflow.dev
- Structured data: WebSite, Organization, SoftwareApplication on the localized home pages
- Crawler rules: https://taskflow-web-syed-ali.vercel.app/robots.txt
- Sitemap: https://taskflow-web-syed-ali.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Localization

Public pages and the dashboard are translated into seven languages. Replace the `/en` prefix with any supported locale to read the same page:

- en — English
- ru — Русский
- es — Español
- ar — العربية (right-to-left layout)
- hi — हिन्दी
- fr — Français
- de — Deutsch

Language alternates and `hreflang` links are declared in page metadata and in `/sitemap.xml`. The language switcher saves the choice in the `tf_locale` cookie and redirects unprefixed URLs to the preferred locale.
